import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-quantitative-indicators', standalone: true, imports: [], templateUrl: './quantitative-indicators.html', styleUrl: './quantitative-indicators.css', }) export class QuantitativeIndicators {}

Quantitative Indicators

(as on 30 Mar 2026)

What is it: It measures how much the fund's returns have varied around their average.

How should you use it: Higher standard deviation usually means higher volatility; pair it with your time horizon and other risk ratios before comparing funds.

14.88%

Standard Deviation

What is it: It shows excess return earned per unit of total risk taken (volatility), after adjusting for the risk‑free rate.

How should you use it: For similar strategies, a higher Sharpe Ratio can indicate better risk‑adjusted outcomes; always interpret using the stated risk‑free assumptions.

0.58

Sharpe Ratio

What is it: It measures excess return earned per unit of market (systematic) risk, expressed via Beta.

How should you use it: Treynor is most meaningful when Beta is credible; combine with Beta and benchmarking context when comparing funds.

8.76

Treynor Ratio

What is it: It tells you by how much the scheme will be impacted compared to the market.

How should you use it: It helps you compare the scheme's sensitivity with market movements. Generally, higher Beta implies higher sensitivity to broad market swings.

0.99

Beta

What is it: It indicates how closely the scheme's performance moves in line with the chosen benchmark.

How should you use it: Higher R‑Squared means the benchmark explains more of returns; Alpha and Beta are more meaningful when R‑Squared is high.

0.96

R-Squared

What is it: It reflects how actively the underlying portfolio has been traded over the period measured.

How should you use it: Higher turnover can relate to churn and implicit costs/tax incidence; weigh it alongside investment style disclosures and AMC practice.

0.42

Portfolio Turnover

Standard Deviation: Monthly rolling returns last 3 years. Sharpe Ratio: Risk-free rate (FIMMDA Overnight MIBOR) 6.98%. No. of Stocks: 85.
